views.name: cards_core_projection
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId,
  cards.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.subtypes AS subtypes,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.isPromo AS isPromo,
  cards.isReprint AS isReprint
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical projection of the cards table exposing stable identifiers and commonly queried card attributes (no filtering). Useful as a normalized base for cohorts, joins, and filters.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_and_legal_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  COALESCE(f.foreign_text_count, 0) AS foreign_text_count,
  COALESCE(l.legalities_count, 0) AS legalities_count
FROM cards_core_projection c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    COUNT(id) AS foreign_text_count
  FROM foreign_data
  GROUP BY uuid
) f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    COUNT(id) AS legalities_count
  FROM legalities
  GROUP BY uuid
) l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
views.description: Per-card aggregated counts of related foreign language entries and legality entries. Keeps one row per card (by uuid) with raw counts to support questions about how many translations or legal entries a card has.

views.name: sets_projection
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  code AS code,
  name AS name,
  releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  type AS type,
  totalSetSize AS totalSetSize,
  isFoilOnly AS isFoilOnly,
  isOnlineOnly AS isOnlineOnly,
  id AS id
FROM sets
views.description: Projection of the sets table exposing identifiers and release metadata for join/filters against cards.setCode.

views.name: cards_rowlevel_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.name AS name,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  c.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId,
  c.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  cards.hasFoil AS hasFoil,
  cards.hasNonFoil AS hasNonFoil,
  cards.availability AS availability
FROM cards AS cards
JOIN cards_core_projection AS c ON c.id = cards.id
views.description: Canonical per-card row projecting and normalizing key identification, availability and print-market fields for reuse. Exposes primary identifiers, marketplace IDs (CardKingdom), foil/non-foil flags, border color, and availability text for card-level filtering and joins.

views.name: cards_cardkingdom_availability_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.cardKingdomId,
  c.cardKingdomFoilId,
  c.hasFoil,
  c.hasNonFoil,
  c.availability
FROM cards_rowlevel_core c
WHERE (c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL OR c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL)

semantic_filters.cardKingdom_presence: cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL OR cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL

views.description: Subset/cohort of cards that have CardKingdom market presence (cardKingdomId present) or CardKingdom foil id present. Useful to identify Marketplace-only availability variations and to filter cards by market listing presence.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_and_legal_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.borderColor AS "cards.borderColor",
  cards.cardKingdomId AS "cards.cardKingdomId",
  cards.cardKingdomFoilId AS "cards.cardKingdomFoilId",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name AS foreign_name",
  legalities.format AS "legalities.format",
  legalities.status AS "legalities.status",
  foreign_data.id AS foreign_id,
  legalities.id AS legality_id
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
LEFT JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized card-level view joining cards to related foreign_data and legalities to provide multilingual names/texts and format legality flags. One row per card per foreign language entry and per legality entry when joined; useful for queries that need card metadata plus language or format legality context. (Consumers should restrict joins or aggregate if they need strictly one row per card.)

views.name: cards_core_attributes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.number AS number,
  c.rarity AS rarity,
  c.manaCost AS manaCost,
  c.colors AS colors,
  c.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  c.types AS types,
  c.subtypes AS subtypes,
  s.releaseDate AS releaseDate
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
views.description: Canonical card printings with primary identifying and commonly filtered attributes (one row per card printing). Normalizes/keeps raw fields useful for filtering and joins (no question-specific literals).

views.name: card_legalities_by_format
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS id,
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status
FROM legalities
views.description: One row per legality record linking a card (by uuid) to a format and its status. Useful to filter cards by format and legality status.
validated_on: List all the card id and artist with unknown power which are legal for commander play format.
Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.

views.name: cards_with_legality_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.setCode AS "cards.setCode",
  cards.number AS "cards.number",
  cards.rarity AS "cards.rarity",
  legalities.id AS "legalities.id",
  legalities.format AS "legalities.format",
  legalities.status AS "legalities.status"
FROM cards
JOIN legalities
  ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view joining card printings to their legalities (one row per card printing x legality record). Exposes card keys and legality fields for filters and outputs needed by many queries.

views.name: cards_core_normalized
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  NULLIF(c.uuid, '') AS uuid,
  NULLIF(c.name, '') AS name,
  NULLIF(c.setCode, '') AS setCode,
  NULLIF(c.type, '') AS type,
  NULLIF(c.types, '') AS types,
  NULLIF(c.side, '') AS side,
  NULLIF(c.manaCost, '') AS manaCost,
  c.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards c
views.description: Normalized / cleaned projection of the cards table exposing canonical id, name, set, face/side indicators and the main type/type tokens useful for filtering and joining. Converts empty strings to NULL where appropriate (logical canonicalization).

views.name: card_with_specific_format_legality
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.setCode AS "cards.setCode",
  cards.type AS "cards.type",
  legalities.format AS "legalities.format",
  legalities.status AS "legalities.status",
  legalities.id AS legalities_id
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized join of cards to legalities for a chosen format. One row per card per format-legal entry (i.e. per legalities.id). Useful for answering queries about a card's legality in a specific format while keeping card attributes accessible.

views.name: cards_rowlevel_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.artist AS artist,
  c.power AS power,
  c.toughness AS toughness,
  c.manaCost AS manaCost,
  c.colors AS colors,
  c.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  c.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards c
views.description: Canonical row-level card relation with cleaned/canonicalized key and frequently-used card attributes (one row per card). Keep raw fields for downstream filtering and joins.

views.name: cards_with_legalities_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.artist AS artist,
  cards.power AS power,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  legalities.id AS legality_id
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized relation joining cards to their legalities (one row per card x legality row). Useful for queries that need card attributes together with format-specific legality status.

views.name: cards_by_artist
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.artist,
  c.hasContentWarning
FROM cards AS c
views.description: One row per card exposing core identifying and display columns for filtering by artist and joining to related tables.

views.name: rulings_by_card_uuid
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  rulings.id AS id,
  rulings.uuid AS uuid,
  rulings.date AS date,
  rulings.text AS text
FROM rulings
views.description: One row per ruling tied to a card uuid; exposes ruling text and date for each ruling associated with a card.
validated_on: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.

views.name: card_rulings_left_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS card_id,
  cards.uuid AS card_uuid,
  cards.name AS card_name,
  cards.artist AS card_artist,
  cards.hasContentWarning AS hasContentWarning,
  rulings.id AS ruling_id,
  rulings.date AS ruling_date,
  rulings.text AS ruling_text
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN rulings
  ON cards.uuid = rulings.uuid
views.description: Denormalized left-join of cards to rulings producing one row per card-ruling pair (cards with no rulings included with ruling fields NULL). Useful for returning all rulings for cards and for per-card aggregation of ruling texts.

views.name: rulings_rows_by_card_uuid
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  rulings.id AS id,
  rulings.uuid AS uuid,
  rulings.date AS date,
  rulings.text AS text
FROM rulings
WHERE rulings.uuid IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cards WHERE cards.uuid = rulings.uuid
  )

semantic_filters.uuid_exists_in_cards: rulings.uuid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cards WHERE cards.uuid = rulings.uuid)

views.description: All rulings rows that reference a card UUID (one row per rulings.id) — a cohort of rulings filtered to those that have a matching card UUID present in the cards table. Keeps original ruling fields for downstream joins/filters.

views.name: cards_core_normalized_17
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.artist AS artist,
  cards.isPromo AS isPromo
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized projection of cards keyed by cards.uuid exposing identity and key attributes useful for joining and filtering (name, artist, isPromo). One row per card (uuid).

views.name: rulings_count_per_card_uuid
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  COUNT(rulings.id) AS rulings_count
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN rulings ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid
GROUP BY cards.uuid
views.description: Count of rulings rows grouped per card UUID. One row per cards.uuid with the integer count of associated rulings entries.

views.name: foreign_data_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  language,
  name,
  text,
  flavorText,
  multiverseid,
  type
FROM foreign_data
views.description: Normalized row-level representation of foreign_data rows exposing identity, language, and text fields for downstream cohorting and aggregation. Includes canonical typed columns and preserves the primary key per row.
validated_on: What is the language of the card with the multiverse number 149934?

views.name: foreign_data_language_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  fd.id AS id,
  fd.language AS language
FROM foreign_data AS fd
views.description: Cohort view grouping foreign_data rows by language; one row per original foreign_data record but annotated to support language-based counts and proportions.

views.name: foreign_data_language_aggregate_by_language
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  language AS language,
  COUNT(*) AS language_count
FROM
  foreign_data
GROUP BY
  language
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of foreign_data rows per language. One row per language value with the count of rows for that language. Useful for percentage computations and language distribution summaries.

views.name: cards_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  TRIM(c.name) AS name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c.power), '') AS power,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c.toughness), '') AS toughness,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c.types), '') AS types,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c.type), '') AS type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(c.manaCost), '') AS manaCost,
  c.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards c
views.description: Canonical normalized projection of the cards table exposing primary identifiers and core attributes (no aggregation). Clean/canonicalize textual columns; preserve one row per card.

views.name: cards_power_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.power AS power,
  CASE
    WHEN c.power IS NULL THEN 0
    WHEN trim(lower(c.power)) IN ('infinite', 'infinity') THEN 1
    WHEN instr(lower(c.power), '∞') > 0 THEN 1
    WHEN instr(lower(c.power), 'affinity') > 0 THEN 1
    WHEN trim(c.power) = '*' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_infinite_power
FROM cards c
views.description: Subset cohort of cards filtered/marked by power-related conditions; exposes raw power value and a boolean flag for infinite power for easy reuse in counts and groupings.

views.name: cards_with_set_info
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.power AS power,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  sets.name AS "sets.name as set_name",
  sets.releaseDate AS "sets.releaseDate",
  sets.type AS "sets.type as set_type"
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
views.description: Denormalized view joining cards to their set metadata (by setCode) to allow filters/group-bys by set attributes (releaseDate, name, type) while keeping one row per card.

views.name: cards_core_projection_25
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical per-card projection with primary identifying columns and commonly queried attributes (casts/NULL-normalization kept minimal). One row per card (row = card record).

views.name: card_legal_and_foreign_lookup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.borderColor AS borderColor,
  l.format AS legal_format,
  l.status AS legal_status,
  f.language AS foreign_language,
  f.name AS foreign_name
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
LEFT JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
views.description: Denormalized per-card row that brings together card identity with related legality and foreign-language rows (one row per card per related-row would be produced if joined naively). Useful to support questions that need card attributes alongside legality or foreign translations. This view intentionally keeps grain as the card id (cards.id) and does NOT aggregate multiple legalities/foreign rows; consumers should add filters or aggregates when they want a single row.

views.name: cards_oracle_text_projection
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.name AS name,
  COALESCE(cards.text, cards.originalText) AS text,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.multiverseId AS multiverseId
FROM cards
views.description: One row per card printing, projecting canonical oracle/rules text and fallback to originalText when text is NULL; exposes identity and key printing columns for filtering and joins.

views.name: cards_identity_and_printing_keys
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  CASE
    WHEN cards.multiverseId = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE cards.multiverseId
  END AS multiverseId,
  cards.scryfallId AS scryfallId,
  cards.mcmId AS mcmId
FROM cards
views.description: Subset of card rows exposing key identity and printing identifiers for filtering, deduping, and joining to related tables (legalities, rulings, foreign_data).

views.name: cards_text_availability_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.multiverseId AS multiverseId,
  CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(c.text, '')) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasText,
  COALESCE(c.hasNonFoil, 0) AS hasNonFoil,
  COALESCE(c.hasFoil, 0) AS hasFoil,
  COALESCE(c.isReprint, 0) AS isReprint
FROM cards c
views.description: Cohort of card printings with indicators about presence of oracle text and other availability flags to help prefer rows when multiple printings exist.

views.name: cards_row_level_30
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.borderColor AS borderColor
FROM cards c
views.description: One canonical row per card, exposing identifying keys and common attributes used for filtering/grouping (keeps raw values, does not aggregate). Normalize/standardize minimal nullable-cleaning where useful.

views.name: cards_bordercohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.borderColor AS borderColor,
  CASE
    WHEN c.borderColor IS NULL THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS is_border_match
FROM cards c
views.description: A reusable cohort view selecting cards by borderColor values. It labels whether each card matches a given borderColor value for easy cohort counting and percentages.

views.name: cards_story_spotlight_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.isStorySpotlight AS isStorySpotlight,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards
WHERE cards.isStorySpotlight = 1
views.description: One-row-per-card cohort of cards that are marked as story spotlight (exposes id and uuid plus key card attributes useful for later filters/joins).

views.name: foreign_texts_by_card
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS id,
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS name,
  foreign_data.text AS text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS flavorText,
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid
FROM foreign_data
views.description: Foreign-language text rows per card (one row per foreign_data.id), normalized language and exposing the card uuid for joins; used to determine which cards have translations in a given language.
validated_on: What are the cards belong to duel deck a? List the ID.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_language_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data f
    WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
      AND f.language = (SELECT NULL) -- placeholder to be replaced by parameterized language in question_ops
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_language_flag
FROM cards c
views.description: One row per card (cards.id) that indicates whether the card has at least one foreign_data row in a specified language. This is a general presence-flag view parameterized later by language in question_ops.

views.name: cards_row_level_35
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.originalType AS originalType,
  c.subtypes AS subtypes
FROM cards c
views.description: Row-level normalized projection of the cards table exposing identity, type, subtypes and other filterable/text columns. Useful as the base cohort for counts or further filters.

views.name: cards_type_subtype_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.originalType,
  c.subtypes,
  -- canonicalize originalType: trim, collapse multiple spaces, lower case
  lower(trim(replace(replace(originalType, char(9), ' '), '  ', ' '))) AS originalType_normalized,
  -- canonicalize subtypes: trim, lower case, remove surrounding commas/spaces, collapse multiple spaces
  lower(trim(replace(replace(subtypes, char(9), ' '), '  ', ' '))) AS subtypes_normalized
FROM cards c
views.description: A selectable cohort view that flags and exposes canonicalized originalType and subtypes for filtering groups of cards by type/subtype membership. Keeps one row per card with derived boolean flags for common comparisons.

views.name: cards_foreign_and_legalities_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.originalType AS "cards.originalType",
  cards.subtypes AS "cards.subtypes",
  foreign_data.id AS "foreign_data.id",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name",
  legalities.id AS "legalities.id",
  legalities.format AS "legalities.format",
  legalities.status AS "legalities.status"
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
LEFT JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view joining cards with their foreign localizations and legalities. One row per combination of card and related foreign/legality row to support queries that need translations or format statuses alongside card attributes.

views.name: cards_row_level_38
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.duelDeck AS duelDeck,
  c.types AS types,
  c.colors AS colors,
  c.manaCost AS manaCost,
  c.rarity AS rarity,
  c.originalReleaseDate AS originalReleaseDate,
  COALESCE(c.isReprint, 0) AS isReprint,
  COALESCE(c.isPromo, 0) AS isPromo,
  COALESCE(c.isOnlineOnly, 0) AS isOnlineOnly
FROM cards c
views.description: One canonical row per card exposing key identity columns and common attributes useful for filtering and projection (no aggregations). Cast/normalize obvious fields and surface columns often used in queries: primary key id, uuid, name, set code, duelDeck, types, colors, manaCost, rarity, release date fields and boolean flags.

views.name: cards_legalities_by_uuid
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS id,
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status
FROM legalities
views.description: Denormalized relation of card uuid to its legalities (one row per legality entry) exposing format and status so queries can filter by legality or join to card rows. Useful for answering questions that combine card attributes with format legality.

views.name: cards_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.rarity AS rarity
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized projection of the cards table with canonical key columns and commonly-filtered attributes (one row per card). Cleans nothing here beyond exposing raw columns useful for filtering and joining to legalities/sets/foreign_data.

views.name: card_legalities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS id,
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  cards.id AS cards_id
FROM legalities
LEFT JOIN cards ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
views.description: Denormalized rows of card legal status per format by joining legalities to cards key (one row per legalities.id). Exposes the uuid link and status which are commonly used to determine bans/restrictions.

views.name: cards_with_legal_status
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS legalities_id,
  cards.id AS cards_id,
  cards.uuid AS cards_uuid,
  cards.name AS cards_name,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  legalities.format AS legal_format,
  legalities.status AS legal_status
FROM legalities
JOIN cards ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: One row per card-legal-record combining card identity with its legality row: exposes card id/uuid/name and legality.format/status to support cohort counts and filters (one row per legalities.id joined to the card it references).

views.name: cards_core_attributes_43
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  NULLIF(cards.name, '') AS name,
  NULLIF(cards.uuid, '') AS uuid,
  NULLIF(cards.originalType, '') AS originalType,
  NULLIF(cards.colors, '') AS colors,
  NULLIF(cards.type, '') AS type,
  NULLIF(cards.rarity, '') AS rarity,
  NULLIF(cards.setCode, '') AS setCode,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards
views.description: One row per card exposing canonical id fields and core attributes used for filtering and display (name, uuid, originalType, colors, type, rarity, setCode, convertedManaCost). Normalize empty strings to NULL where appropriate.

views.name: card_foreign_translations
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS id,
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS name,
  foreign_data.text AS text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS flavorText,
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid
FROM foreign_data
WHERE foreign_data.language IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per foreign_data translation entry linked to a card uuid. Exposes translation language, localized name/text/flavor and the foreign_data primary key for deduplication.

views.name: cards_with_translations_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.originalType AS originalType,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  foreign_data.id AS foreign_id,
  foreign_data.language AS foreign_language,
  foreign_data.name AS foreign_name,
  foreign_data.text AS foreign_text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS foreign_flavorText
FROM cards
JOIN foreign_data ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view joining cards (card-level) to their foreign_data translations (translation-level). One row per (cards.id, foreign_data.id) pairing — i.e., each card translated into a specific language yields one row. Useful for queries that need card attributes alongside each translation.

views.name: cards_cohort_by_layout_frame_border_availability
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,

  c.borderColor AS borderColor,

  c.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards c
views.description: Row-level cohort of cards with core identifying and printable attributes used for filtering card sets and availability. One row per card (card instance across sets/prints as represented in the cards table).

views.name: cards_canonical_mana_and_dimensions
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.manaCost AS manaCost,

    ELSE c.convertedManaCost
  END AS convertedManaCost,

FROM cards c
views.description: Normalized projection of cards exposing canonical manaCost and key dimensions/flags useful across queries (casts and NULL-normalization). Keeps one row per card id and preserves original manaCost text.

views.name: card_legalities_by_uuid
views.body_sql:
SELECT

  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",

  legalities.format AS "legalities.format",
  legalities.status AS "legalities.status"
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized relation joining cards to their legalities (one row per card-legal-format). Useful when filtering cards by legality or enumerating formats/statuses per card.

views.name: cards_core_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  CASE WHEN cards.isStorySpotlight IS NOT NULL AND cards.isStorySpotlight <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isStorySpotlight,
  CASE WHEN cards.isTextless IS NOT NULL AND cards.isTextless <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isTextless
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical per-card row exposing identity and normalized boolean flag columns used for filtering (story spotlight, textless) and key id for joins.

views.name: cards_basic_metadata
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.type AS type,
  c.text AS text,
  -- normalized indicators: prefer stored flags if present, otherwise infer from text NULL/empty
  CASE
    WHEN c.isTextless IS NOT NULL THEN c.isTextless
    WHEN c.text IS NULL THEN 1
    WHEN trim(c.text) = '' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS isTextless,
  CASE
    WHEN c.isStorySpotlight IS NOT NULL THEN c.isStorySpotlight
    ELSE 0
  END AS isStorySpotlight
FROM cards c
views.description: Per-card basic metadata useful for many questions: identity, textual fields presence, set code and type info. Includes normalized indicators for presence/absence of text and name.

views.name: sets_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  code AS code,
  name AS name,
  block AS block,
  type AS type,

FROM sets
views.description: One row per set with canonical set-level fields useful for filtering and joining (basic projection + type casting where applicable).

views.name: set_translations_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT

FROM set_translations
views.description: One row per set translation entry exposing language and setCode for filtering and joins. Keeps translation text and language per translation record.

views.name: sets_with_translation_language
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sets.code AS code,
  sets.name AS name,
  sets.block AS block,
  set_translations.id AS set_translation_id,

  set_translations.translation AS set_translation_text
FROM sets
JOIN set_translations ON set_translations.setCode = sets.code
views.description: Denormalized rows for sets that have translations, one row per (sets.code, set_translations.id) linking sets to their translations and exposing both set code and translation language for easy cohort selection and aggregation.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_language_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  fd.language AS language_present
FROM cards_core_projection AS c
JOIN foreign_data_row_level AS fd
  ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.id, fd.language
views.description: One row per card (cards.uuid) for cards that have at least one foreign_data row in a given language. Exposes card id/uuid and the linked foreign_data language for filtering and joins.

views.name: cards_type_fields_normalized
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  'supertypes' AS type_source,
  c.supertypes AS value
FROM cards c
WHERE c.supertypes IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(c.supertypes) <> ''
UNION ALL
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  'subtypes' AS type_source,
  c.subtypes AS value
FROM cards c
WHERE c.subtypes IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(c.subtypes) <> ''
views.description: Normalized projection of cards' type-related text fields (supertypes and subtypes). Produces one row per card per source column value (no splitting of comma lists) and filters out NULL or empty-string values so downstream queries can directly select non-empty types.

views.name: german_cards_distinct_types
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  'originalType' AS type_source,
  c.originalType AS value,
  f.language AS language
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE f.language IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.language) <> ''
UNION
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  'subtypes' AS type_source,
  c.subtypes AS value,
  f.language AS language
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.subtypes IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(c.subtypes) <> ''
  AND f.language IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.language) <> ''

semantic_filters.language: placeholder — do not hardcode (apply language filter in question_ops)

views.description: Denormalized relation joining cards with foreign_data to limit to cards that have foreign_data in a particular language, then projecting the card's supertypes and subtypes (non-null, non-empty). Useful for queries that need distinct type tokens for cards available in a given language.

views.name: cards_row_level_57

SELECT

views.name: cards_text_indexable
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  lower(
    coalesce(c.name, '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(c.text, '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(c.originalText, '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(c.flavorText, '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(c.asciiName, '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(c.subtypes, '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(c.types, '') || ' ' ||
    coalesce(c.keywords, '')
  ) AS normalized_text,
  c.power AS power
FROM cards c
WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL
views.description: Subset of cards with normalized searchable text and key identity columns to support case-insensitive text searches and cohorts defined by missing or special-power values.

views.name: cards_power_state_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.power,
  CASE
    WHEN c.power IS NULL THEN 'unknown_null'
    WHEN TRIM(c.power) = '*' THEN 'unknown_special'
    ELSE 'known'
  END AS power_state
FROM cards c
views.description: Cohort view that classifies cards by whether power is known, unknown (NULL), or special-unknown ('*'), exposing a flag useful for counts and groupings.

views.name: cards_row_level_60
views.body_sql:

FROM cards

views.name: cards_core_attributes_61

views.name: cards_core_attributes_67

views.name: cards_core_69
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  -- normalize power: trim whitespace; keep NULL if empty string
  CASE
    WHEN trim(c.power) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE trim(c.power)
  END AS power,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards c
views.description: Normalized projection of cards with canonical key columns and cleaned power indicator for each card row.

views.name: cards_powerless_with_language_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  CASE
    WHEN (c.power IS NULL OR trim(c.power) = '') THEN 1
    WHEN lower(trim(c.power)) IN ('*','-','?') THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_powerless,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data f
      WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
      -- language to be provided at query time by filtering outside this view
      LIMIT 1
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS has_language_translation
FROM cards c

semantic_filters.is_powerless_definition: power NULL/empty or special markers considered powerless; language filter deferred to outer query

views.name: cards_row_level_73
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.isTextless AS isTextless,
  c.layout AS layout
FROM cards c
views.description: Row-level canonicalized projection of the cards table exposing primary key and columns commonly used for filtering, grouping, and boolean flags. Keeps one row per card.

views.name: cards_text_and_layout_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  -- normalize isTextless flag: prefer explicit isTextless column when present; fallback to text IS NULL/empty
  CASE
    WHEN c.isTextless IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN c.isTextless <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    WHEN c.text IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN TRIM(c.text) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_textless_flag,
  -- canonicalize layout: lowercased, trimmed, map common variants to canonical forms
  LOWER(TRIM(
    CASE
      WHEN c.layout IS NOT NULL THEN c.layout
      WHEN c.side IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.side) <> '' THEN c.side
      ELSE ''
    END
  )) AS layout_canonical
FROM cards c
views.description: Cohort of cards annotated with normalized boolean flags for textlessness and canonicalized layout string for reliable filtering.

views.name: cards_counts_by_layout_and_textless
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  layout,
  COALESCE(isTextless, 0) AS isTextless,
  COUNT(id) AS cards_count
FROM cards
GROUP BY layout, COALESCE(isTextless, 0)
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of cards grouped by layout and isTextless flag. Useful for quickly computing percentages or distributions across layouts and textlessness.
